description: Is a question about a rate decision or a government bond auction settleable, when, and on which source? Finds the bank (or the auction issuer, tenor) and the date in the text. Refuses a decision or auction that has not been observed: a decision settles only after its statement is observed on the bank's own page, an auction only once the issuer's result is recorded (it says when bidding closes, closeAt in UTC, and on which result page). Also says when the source has not yet met the reads bar (5 right, 0 wrong).

text.description: The question, e.g. "Will the RBI raise its repo rate on 7 Oct 2026?" or "Will the German 30-year Bund auction on 14 Oct 2026 have a bid-to-cover above 1.5?"

name: check_question
title: Check a question
